pl-l3d39c6-d1e115.summary: Asks who is more bound, one who swears by God, by the Gospel, or by creatures, and answers: one who swears by God, since these were made through him.
claims: An oath by God binds most.

pl-l3d39c6-d1e118.summary: Quotes Chrysostom: some think swearing by God is a small thing but swearing by the Gospel greater. Fools! The Scriptures are holy because of God, not God because of the Scriptures; so too creatures are holy through God.
claims: Scripture is holy because of God, not God because of Scripture.

pl-l3d39c6.summary: Asks who is more bound: one who swears by God, or by the Gospel or creatures. One who swears by God, since all those things were made through him. Chrysostom mocks those who think swearing by the Gospel greater: the Scriptures are holy because of God, not God because of the Scriptures; so too creatures are holy through God.
claims: An oath by God binds more than one by the Gospel or creatures.
The Scriptures and creatures are holy because of God.
